**Weight**: 5% total (1% each)

**Due**: Wednesday 2026-09-09 and Thursday 2026-09-10 (see the table)

**Submit to**: four different places (see the table)

## Why this page exists

These five tasks are small,
they are each worth 1%,
and they are easy to miss because none of them are submitted the same way.

They are listed here so that everything you owe in this course
is in the one place you already look.
Canvas remains the place with the actual links and instructions.
This page is the checklist.

Note the deadlines.
They are **Wednesday and Thursday**,
not the usual Saturday 6 PM.
Week 1 is front-loaded on purpose,
so that anything broken on your machine turns up
before Milestone 1 is due on the Saturday.

### Setup

Install the MDS software stack and confirm it works.
Submitted on Canvas.

Copy/paste all the output from the mds-setup-check.sh script you run at the very end.

This is graded for completion,
if something is `MISSING` you won't loose points, but do make sure your instructor knows,
and you know how to deal with the `MISSING` status

Do this one first.
Everything else in Week 1 assumes your machine is working,
and this is the task that finds out whether it is.

### Policies

Read the program policies and answer the questions on PrairieLearn.

This is also your first time using PrairieLearn,
which you will meet again in the weekly practice questions
and in a graded setting in another course.

### Student information survey

A short survey so the teaching team knows who you are.

### Lab 0a: Python and Lab 0b: R

You will get these in the **UBC Github Enterprise (GHE)** account.

Two short labs,
one per language,
submitted to Gradescope.

They check that your Python and R installations
can actually run and submit work,
not that you already know the languages.
